notes: 2026-01-15 - Initial inbound from platform team. High-level interest in dedicated GPU pool for latency-critical chat and routing use cases.

2026-02-02 - AE + SE workshop. Agreed POC scope: Dedicated evaluation with throughput and latency SLO verification, soak test, and reserved GPU sizing exercise.

POC scope (agreed): 1) Load tests (ramp/steady/soak), 2) Representative prompt set for chat and reranking, 3) Quantification of reserved GPU needs and burst plan, 4) Clear acceptance criteria and SLA language to negotiate.

Representative workload details: target sustained throughput 120 req/s for chat (avg payload ~300 tokens), peak bursts up to 250 req/s; embeddings/semantic search batch throughput 60 qps; reranking parallelization for top-k=50.
Latency SLOs requested by customer: p95 <= 150ms (single-turn chat, <=512 tokens), p99 <= 450ms; throughput guarantee during business hours (08:00-20:00) for NA/EU regions.

Reserved GPU planning: customer expects initial pool equivalent to 8x A100-80GB for steady-state, autoscale burst to 12 GPUs for scheduled peak windows. Wants cost/benefit comparison of different quantization profiles.

POC acceptance criteria: sustain 100 rps for 1 hour with p95 < 200ms and p99 < 500ms, overall error rate <1%, KV/prefix cache hit rate >40% on simulated workload, cost estimate for 1M tokens under $120 (budget target).
Load test plan (SE notes):
- Ramp: 0 -> 150 rps over 20 minutes; hold 1 hour at 100 rps; burst tests: 250 rps for 5 min; soak: 72 hours at 80-120 rps mixed traffic
- Traffic mix: 70% chat single-turn, 20% chat multi-turn (context size 3-5), 8% embeddings, 2% reranking
- Synthetic users mimic NA/EU distribution; token length distribution from production sample (median 280, 95th 520).
Initial bench results (2026-03-07 internal run): sustained 110 rps on 6x A100-equivalent with p95=180ms, p99=540ms (needs tuning). Noted spike events when KV cache miss ratio increased.

Tuning actions scheduled: update runtime kernel selection for 512-length paths, enable more aggressive prefix caching, test different batching windows and model quantization options (int8 vs int4 variants).
